items.title: 2026-018: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP
items.summary: On 20 October 2026, the PHP project announced an upcoming security release addressing two critical vulnerabilities in PHP. Public reports indicated that these vulnerabilities could lead to remote code execution (RCE). The PHP team released the fixes today, 21 October 2026 at 13:30 UTC, in PHP versions 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. Both vulnerabilities can allow unauthenticated remote code execution. items.title: 2026-019: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
items.summary: On 21 October 2026, GitLab published a security advisory addressing several vulnerabilities among which a critical flaw that could allow an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on a GitLab server. CERT-EU recommends organisations to update affected assets as soon as possible, prioritising internet facing assets, and to run an assessment to identify compromised assets.

items.title: 2026-017: Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
items.summary: On 14 October 2026, Cisco published a security advisory addressing a critical vulnerability affecting the Advanced Malware Protection (AMP) feature of Cisco Secure Email Gateway. This vulnerability could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker to write arbitrary files and execute commands with root privileges on the underlying operating system. The Cisco PSIRT is aware of active exploitation of this vulnerability. CERT-EU strongly recommends up

items.title: 2026-016: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab CE and EE
items.summary: On 12 October 2026, GitLab released versions 19.4.2, 19.3.4 and 19.2.8 of GitLab Community Edition (CE) and Enterprise Edition (EE), fixing 24 security issues among which a critical vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code on the server. CERT-EU strongly recommends upgrading self-managed GitLab CE/EE instances to a fixed version as soon as possible, starting with internet-facing instances.

items.title: 2026-015: Critical Vulnerability in Multiple Atlassian Products
items.summary: On 5 October 2026, Atlassian published a security advisory addressing a critical arbitrary file access vulnerability. It affects Bitbucket Data Center, Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center, Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye. items.title: 2026-013: Critical Vulnerability in F5 BIG-IP APM
items.summary: On 22 September 2026, F5 published an advisory addressing a critical vulnerability affecting its BIG-IP APM product. The vendor confirmed active exploitation in the wild. CERT-EU recommends taking appropriate actions as soon as possible.
